grammar:can-i-get-you-offer-food-drink.title: Can I get you...? 主动提供食物饮料
grammar:can-i-get-you-offer-food-drink.explanation: Can I get you...? 是口语中主动问别人要不要某物的自然句型，常用于主人待客、餐厅服务或朋友之间拿饮料食物。
grammar:can-i-get-you-offer-food-drink.example: Can I get you some coffee or orange juice?

grammar:continue-proceed-complement-patt.title: continue 与 proceed 的后接结构
grammar:continue-proceed-complement-patt.explanation: continue doing 与 continue to do 通常都表示继续做某事；continue with 后接名词。proceed to 后接地点或动词原形，proceed with 后接事情或计划。
grammar:continue-proceed-complement-patt.source: continue doing, continue to do, continue with, proceed to, proceed with
grammar:continue-proceed-complement-patt.example: After a short break, we continued discussing the plan.

grammar:could-you-polite-request.title: Could you...? 礼貌请求
grammar:could-you-polite-request.explanation: Could you...? 常用来礼貌地请别人做事，比直接用 Do it 或 Can you...? 更柔和，适合家庭、朋友和服务场景。
grammar:could-you-polite-request.example: Could you slice the bread while I pour the coffee?

grammar:ill-volunteer-to-do-something.title: I’ll... 主动承担任务
grammar:ill-volunteer-to-do-something.explanation: I’ll 加动词原形可以表示说话人当场决定或主动承担某个任务，常用于分工、帮忙和即时回应。
grammar:ill-volunteer-to-do-something.example: I’ll stir the eggs while you make the toast.

grammar:may-condition-if.title: may + 动词与 if 条件从句
grammar:may-condition-if.explanation: may suffer 表示可能发生；if 引导条件从句，说明产生这种可能结果的条件。一般事实或现实可能条件中，if 从句常用一般现在时。
grammar:may-condition-if.source: A young man may suffer from the green-eyed monster if his girlfriend begins going out with someone else
grammar:may-condition-if.example: You may feel nervous if you speak in public for the first time.

grammar:mean-that-object-clause.title: mean 后接宾语从句
grammar:mean-that-object-clause.explanation: mean 后可直接接省略 that 的宾语从句，说明某个标志、事实或行为所表示的含义。
grammar:mean-that-object-clause.source: A green light on a traffic signal means your car can continue on
grammar:mean-that-object-clause.example: A flashing light means you should slow down.

grammar:participial-phrase-logical-subje.title: 分词短语的逻辑主语
grammar:participial-phrase-logical-subje.explanation: 句首分词短语没有明写主语时，其动作的执行者通常必须与主句主语一致；否则容易形成悬垂修饰语。
grammar:participial-phrase-logical-subje.source: After reviewing the safety report, officials have decided to proceed with the project next Monday.
grammar:participial-phrase-logical-subje.example: After checking the map, we chose a different route.

grammar:past-perfect-before-past-referen.title: 过去完成时表示过去参照点之前
grammar:past-perfect-before-past-referen.explanation: had just arrived 表示“刚刚到达”发生在 used it to describe 这一过去行为之前；just 强调时间间隔很短。
grammar:past-perfect-before-past-referen.source: Old-timers used it to describe a man who had just arrived from one of the big cities back east
grammar:past-perfect-before-past-referen.example: They welcomed a traveler who had just arrived from Boston.

grammar:while-clause-simultaneous-action.title: while 从句表示同时动作
grammar:while-clause-simultaneous-action.explanation: while 可以连接两个同时发生的动作，结构常见为 do something while someone does something，用来说明分工或背景动作。
grammar:while-clause-simultaneous-action.source: No problem. I'll stir the eggs while you make the toast.
grammar:while-clause-simultaneous-action.example: I’ll wash the cups while you set the table.
